inputSchema.description: Request schema for updating the deactivation status of an organization member.

idMember.description: The ID of the member whose deactivation status is to be updated. Note: You cannot deactivate yourself. Example: '5a7e5c9e4a5a8c0f2a7b6c3e'.
idMember.title: Id Member

idOrg.description: The ID or name of the Trello organization (workspace). Example: '5a7e5c9e4a5a8c0f2a7b6c3d' or 'myworkspace'.
idOrg.title: Id Org

value.description: Required. Set to 'true' to deactivate the member (suspend their access temporarily) or 'false' to reactivate them.
value.title: Value

inputSchema.title: UpdateOrganizationsMembersDeactivationByIdOrgByIdMemberRequest

UpdateOrganizationsMembersDeactivationBy.description:
Response schema for updating the deactivation status of an organization member.

This endpoint returns an empty response body on success. The HTTP status code 200 OK
indicates successful deactivation or reactivation of the organization member. The
operation is controlled by the 'value' parameter in the request (true to deactivate,
false to reactivate).
